description: Use this when the user wants ideas or recipes to cook, by dish, ingredient, cuisine, diet, time or rating, or just wants to browse. query is optional: leave it out to browse by tags and sort. Searches the public Only Recipes library and returns a grid of recipes. Not for the user's own recipes (use list_my_recipes) or for a pasted link (use import_recipe). Plain keywords need no filters; call get_filters first only to filter by tag. Without a linked account, query matches whole words and word prefixes in the recipe name, a short description summary and tag slugs (not arbitrary substrings), results can lag new recipes and votes by up to a day, and sourceUrl is always null.

query.description: Text search query to match recipe name or description

sort.description: Sort order: recent (newest), popular (most votes), rating (highest rated), trending (recently imported)

name: search_recipes
title: Search recipes
